blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence’s predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. Hajdik et al. (2019) used the ERG’s treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Opus 5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE’s own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus’s own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F 1 on the graph’s predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.
blocks.zh: 英语资源语法(英語:ERG)是英语的手写计算语法. 由于一个句子,它的处理器ACE产生了一种形式意义代表,称为"最小回溯语义"(MRS):句子的上游及其论据的图. 语法是双向的,也可以将 MRS 转换为英语句子. Hajdik等人(2019年)利用ERG的树库为这一代任务建立了基准,MRS用于文字,并训练了顺序到顺序模型来解决. 解析任务,文本到MRS,可以在相同的句子上测试. 我们重建了他们的10K-判决测试分数,并得分两个大语言模型,克劳德·索内特4.5和克劳德·奥普斯5,双向对准他们训练有素的系统,对准ACE,没有任务特定训练. 鉴于一个MRS和三个例子,Opus将句子写为76.3 BLEU,比他们的系统高10分,训练为72k对(66.1 BLEU),与他们的系统相当,训练为100万对(77.2 BLEU)。 Sonnet的得分是65.7 BLEU, 让它在ACE自己的候选判决中选择, 奥普斯自己在候选人中的判决增加了0.6分(77.0 BLEU). 然而,在解析方向上,模型远远落后于ACE:要求相同句子的MRS,在图的上游和对91.0的论据上分别达到57.2(Sonnet)和65.5(Opus)F1,并在约1%的句子上精确比对黄金. 我们描述解析任务的失败模式,并得出结论,仅一代分数并不能表明模型理解正式语义表达.

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example sentence where all three systems realize the reference exactly and only ACE parses it exactly. Given the gold MRS (linearized for the LLMs), ACE, Sonnet and Opus all write the reference sentence. Given the sentence, only ACE recovers the MRS. Both LLMs split the particle verb send back , which the ERG treats as one predicate, and use predicates for how that the ERG does not have. Red marks predicates that differ from gold. The last column is the spans-off EDM F 1 .
blocks.zh: 图1:一个例子句,所有三个系统都完全实现参照,只有ACE精确地将其描述. 鉴于金色的MRS(为LLMS线性),ACE,Sonnet和Opus都写了参考句. 鉴于这一判决,只有ACE恢复MRS. 两种LLMs将粒子动词分解回送,ERG将其视为一个上游,并使用上游来表示ERG没有的. 红色标记与黄金不同。 最后一栏是跨度EDM F 1。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The English Resource Grammar (ERG; Flickinger, 2000 ) is a hand-written, broad-coverage grammar of English. Its processor, ACE ( Crysmann and Packard, 2012 ) , parses a sentence into Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS; Copestake et al., 2005 ), a graph whose nodes are the sentence’s predicates and whose edges are their argument roles, with quantifier scope left underspecified, and runs backwards to generate from a given MRS the sentences it represents. The Redwoods treebank ( Oepen et al., 2004 ) pairs sentences from newswire, Wikipedia, tourism prose, fiction and dialogue with their hand-selected gold MRS (about ten thousand in its test partition). Hajdik et al. (2019) turned this treebank into a benchmark for the generation direction, MRS to text: each gold MRS linearized (as Dependency MRS, Copestake, 2009 , in PENMAN form), trained a sequence-to-sequence model on 72k pairs, using BLEU to score against the original sentence. Their systems reach 66.11 BLEU on the 10K test split, and 77.17 with about a million extra silver pairs parsed automatically from newswire. Because the grammar is bidirectional, the same split poses the reverse task, text to MRS, on the same sentences, with ACE as a reference in both directions. A prompted language model needs no task-specific training for either, so the same system can be scored both ways on identical items. We use Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Opus 5 with three exemplars each, and ask three research questions.
blocks.zh: 英语资源语法(英語:ERG;Flickinger,2000 )是英语的一种手写,广义的覆盖语法. 它的处理器ACE(Crysmann and Packard, 2012)将一个句子分解为最小的Recursion Semantics(MRS; Copestake等人,2005年),这个图的节点是句子的上游,其边缘是其辩证角色,其限定范围未下定义,向后运行以从给定的 MRS 生成它所代表的句子. Redwoods treebank (Oepen et al., 2004) 配对句子来自新闻网,维基百科,旅游流言,虚构和与他们亲手挑选的黄金MRS的对话(其测试分区中约一万段). Hajdik 等人(2019年)将这个树库变成了生成方向的基准,MRS改为文本:每个黄金的MRS线性化(as Dependency MRS, Copestake, 2009, in PENMAN形式),在72k对上训练一个序列对序列模型,使用BLEU比对原句得分. 他们的系统在10K测试分解时达到了66.11BLEU,77.17则有约一百万额外的银对从新闻线上自动解析. 由于语法是双向的,同样的分法会产生反向的任务,文本到MRS,在相同的句子上,以ACE作为双向的参考. 一个被激发的语言模型不需要对两者进行特定任务的培训,因此同一系统可以在相同的项目上双向打分. 我们用Claude Sonnet 4.5和Claude Opus 5, 每人三个例子, 并问三个研究问题。

blocks.en: Yes, and Opus beats it (Table 1 ): Opus 5 scores 76.34 BLEU, 10 points above the 72k-pair trained seq2seq system, and on par with the million-pair silver-data trained system. Sonnet 4.5 obtains 65.65 BLEU matching the trained 72k-pair system. These public sentences predate both models’ training cutoffs and we run a substitution control to test memorization which shows relatively small memorization effects(§ 3 ). Parsed back through the grammar, the models’ sentences recover the input MRS at 85.4 (Sonnet) and 89.8 (Opus) spans-off EDM F 1 against 91.0 for the gold sentences themselves, so high BLEU here reflects preserved meaning, not surface overlap alone.
blocks.zh: 是的,奥普斯击败它(表1): Opus 5的得分为76.34 BLEU,高于72k-pair训练的以下2seq系统10分,与百万pair训练的银数据系统相当. Sonnet 4.5获得65.65BLEU匹配训练有素的72k-pair系统. 这些公开判决早于两个模型的训练截断,我们运行一个替代控制来测试记忆,显示相对较少的记忆效果(§ 通过语法解析回来,模型的句子在85.4(Sonnet)和89.8(Opus)之间恢复输入的MRS,黄金句子本身的EDM F 1对91.0,如此高的BLEU反映了保留的意义,而不是表面重叠。

blocks.en: It helps the weaker model, Sonnet: ACE generates candidates for 79% of the items, its top-10 best list holds realizations its ranker does not surface, and Sonnet as a fluency judge over that list (using Sonnet’s own sentence where ACE abstains) reaches 69.64 BLEU on the test split, four points over Sonnet alone (Table 1 ). For Opus, we use a pooled judge that keeps Opus’s own sentence among the candidates and this shows a gain of about 0.6 0.6 BLEU, which shows that the grammar helps both models with diminishing returns for the stronger model.
blocks.zh: 它帮助较弱的模型Sonnet:ACE为79%的项目生成候选者,其前十名的列表持有它的分级表不会浮出水面,而Sonnet作为该列表的流利裁判(使用Sonnet自己的句子,其中ACE弃权)在测试分数上达到69.64 BLEU,单是Sonnet(表1)就有4分. 对奥普斯来说,我们使用一个集合法官来将奥普斯自己的刑期保留在候选人中,这显示了大约0.6 0.6 BLEU的增益,这表明语法帮助了两个模型,减少了对更强模型的回报.

blocks.en: Not reliably. When we ask for the MRS of the same sentences, Sonnet reaches only 57.2 span-free EDM F 1 and Opus 65.5 compared to 91.0 for ACE’s parser, matching the gold analysis exactly on 0.6% and 1.4% of items against 50.5% for ACE (Table 3 ). The outputs are structure-formatted correctly and almost always decode as MRS but what fails is the grammar’s conventions, the predicate inventory and the argument frames (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 并不可靠, 无法相信。 当我们要求相同句子的 MRS 时, Sonnet 仅达到 57.2 无间断 EDM F 1 和 Opus 65.5 , 而 ACE 的 解析器为 91.0 , 黄金分析完全对应 0.6% 和 1.4% , 而 ACE 则为 50.5%(表 3)。 产出结构格式正确,几乎总是解码为MRS,但失败的是语法惯例、上游清单和参数框架(第4节)。

blocks.en: Limits of LLMs as AMR analysts have been reported ( Ettinger et al., 2023 ) and the producing/understanding gap mentioned in West et al. (2024) , ERG lets us measure it on the same benchmark with a grammar as the reference both ways.
blocks.zh: Ettinger等人,2023年)和West等人(2024年)提到的生产/理解差距,ERG让我们以语法作为双向参考,用同样的基准来衡量。

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: We take the ERG-1214 gold profiles and run Hajdik et al. ’s released conversion unchanged, so inputs and references match their files exactly yielding 10,201 test items over 37 Redwoods profiles.
blocks.zh: 我们使用ERG-1214金币配置图 运行 Hajdik et al. 因此输入和引用都与他们的文件完全一致,

blocks.en: Q1, realization : linearized MRS → \rightarrow sentence over the full test split. Q2, reranking : Sonnet, as a fluency judge, chooses among ACE’s 10-best sentences, the model’s own prediction filling in where ACE produces nothing ( hybrid ) and a pooled variant that adds the model’s own sentence to the list. Q3, analysis : sentence → \rightarrow SimpleMRS on a fixed-seed 1,000-item sample stratified on the newswire data (whose gold MRS passes through the evaluator unchanged) are scored.
blocks.zh: Q1, 实现 : 线性化 MRS →\ 右旋句子在全测试分裂上 。 Q2, 重排: Sonnet作为流利的法官, 在ACE的10个最佳句子中选择, Q3,分析:句子~\右旋简单MRS在新闻线数据上固定种子1000项样本分级(其黄金MRS通过评价者没有改变)的分数.

blocks.en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 ( 20250929 ) and Claude Opus 5 with three fixed exemplars from outside the scored items. Sonnet ran with greedy decoding and a 3,000-token budget, and Opus 5 runs with default thinking.
blocks.zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (20250929 ))和克劳德·奥普斯 5 配有三个来自得分项目以外的固定实例. Sonnet以贪婪的解码和3000token的预算运行,Opus 5以默认思维运行.

blocks.en: ACE 0.9.31 with ERG 1214, as realizer ( n n -best 10, 10 s per item) and parser (top-1). ACE is in-sample: the gold MRSs are ERG-1214 analyses, and its ranking model was trained on Redwoods, including these profiles.
blocks.zh: ACE 0.9.31与ERG 1214,作为实现器(nn - best 10, 10 s每件)和剖面器(top-1). ACE是实例:黄金MRS是ERG-1214分析,其排名模型接受了红杉(Redwoods)培训,包括这些简介.

blocks.en: Realization is scored by SacreBLEU (exponential smoothing) Post (2018) against the original sentence after their post-processing. Parsing is scored on the EDS reduction of each MRS ( Oepen and Lønning, 2006 ) with three metrics (App. A ). EDM F 1 ( Dridan and Oepen, 2011 ) matches predicates and argument triples, either anchored to their character spans or with spans removed so that nodes are keyed by predicate name alone. Exact match requires the predicted and gold graphs to be isomorphic once spans are ignored. Smatch ( Cai and Knight, 2013 ) matches triples under the node alignment that maximizes agreement, so it is invariant to variable names.
blocks.zh: 实现由SacreBLEU(负责平滑)Post(2018年)在他们的后处理后对原句打分. 在每个MRS(Oepen和Lønning,2006年)的EDS减量中,分数为3分(App.A)。 EDM F 1 (Dridan and Oepen, 2011) 匹配上游和争辩三重奏, 要么固定在它们的字符跨度上, 要么去掉跨度, 以便节点仅由上游名称键入. 精确匹配需要预测的和金色的图表在跨度被忽略后成为异形. Smatch (Cai and Knight, 2013))在节点对齐下匹配三重音,使协议最大化,因此它对于可变名称是不可变的.

blocks.en: Table 1: Q1 realization on Hajdik et al. ’s split and the Q2 hybrids (Sonnet as judge throughout: its pick where ACE generates, the model’s prediction elsewhere).
blocks.zh: 表1:Hajdik等人的Q1实现情况 其分裂与Q2杂交(Sonnet作为整个评断者:它选择ACE生成的地方,模型在其他地方的预测).

blocks.en: 3 Realization
blocks.zh: 3 实现

blocks.en: Table 1 shows both LLMs with three prompted exemplars, evaluated on the same linearized MRS test set as the trained systems from Hajdik et al. (2019) . Sonnet 4.5 matches the trained 72k-pair (gold-only) system and Opus 5 is 8-10 points above it essentially tied with the million-pair (gold+silver) trained system. We also compare this to ACE which realizes 79.2% of the split at 61.81 BLEU.
blocks.zh: 表1显示了两个LLMs,其中有三个催化实例,与Hajdik等人(2019年)的经过培训的系统在同一组线化的MRS测试中进行了评估。 Sonnet 4.5与训练有素的72k-pair(只有金色)系统匹配,Opus 5则比它高出8-10分,基本上与训练有素的百万pair(金色+银色)系统搭配. 我们还将这与ACE进行比较,后者在61.81BLEU中实现了79.2%的拆分.

blocks.en: BLEU measures overlap with the reference, not preservation of the input, so we parse each system’s sentence back with ACE and score the parse against the input MRS: its parse of the gold sentence itself scores 91.0 spans-off EDM F 1 on the 1K items (92.6 on the 762 ACE generates for), exact on 50.5%. Sonnet’s sentences score 85.4 (exact 28.6%; 96.1% parse), Opus’s 89.8 (38.9%; 96.7%); ACE’s own realization and the judge’s pick score 94.5 and 94.3 on the 762. Opus’s sentences sit within 1.2 points of the gold sentence’s own reparse, Sonnet’s within 5.6: the realizations largely preserve the input’s predicates and arguments (App. A ).
blocks.zh: BLEU的计量与参考重合,而不是保存输入,所以我们分析每个系统的句子与ACE重合,并比照输入的MRS进行评分:其黄金句子本身在1K项目(762 ACE生成的92.6)上评分为91.0跨度EDM F 1,精确为50.5%. Sonnet的判罚得分85.4分(准确28.6%;96.1% 剖析),Opus的89.8分(38.9%;96.7%);ACE自己的实现和裁判的挑剔得分94.5分和94.3分在762分. 奥普斯的句子在黄金句子的1.2分,索内特在5.6分之内:实现在很大程度上保留了输入的前提和论据(App.A.

blocks.en: Table 2: Q2, where ACE generates. c Per item the highest sentence-BLEU candidate which is a ceiling. Sonnet scores 62.56 and Opus 73.72 on the subset that ACE abstains (2,067 items) on.
blocks.zh: 表2: ACE生成的Q2. c 每个项目的最高刑期为最高额。 Sonnet在ACE弃权的子集(2,067项)上得62.56分和Opus 73.72分.

blocks.en: Here we focus on the examples ACE generates successfully on, to see how much the grammar helps in a hybrid system. We see that on this subset the top-10 often has the correct sentence but the ACE ranking is poor (Table 2 ): ACE ranks its realizations with the Redwoods parse-selection model ( redwoods.mem , the only model its configuration loads) but it has no ranker trained for realization ( Velldal and Oepen, 2005 ; Velldal and Oepen, 2006 ) . Its first choice scores 61.82, the shortest candidate 69.01, Sonnet as a fluency judge 71.25 ( + 9.4 +9.4 , on this subset). The judge’s pick also beats Sonnet’s own generation by 4.2 points, and the hybrid scores 69.64 on the full split, four points over Sonnet alone.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们集中研究ACE成功生成的例子,看看语法对混合系统有多大帮助. 我们可以看到,在这个子集上,前十名经常有正确的句子,但是ACE排名是差的(表2):ACE用红杉的剖析-选择模型(红杉.mem,其唯一的配置负载模型)来排序它的实现,但它没有经过实现训练的排名(Velldal和Oepen,2005年;Velldal和Oepen,2006年). 其首选得分61.82,最短的候选人69.01,索内作为流利裁判71.25(+9.4+9.4,在这个子集上). 评委的选手还以4.2分的优势战胜了索内特自己的一代人,混合选手在完全分数上得分69.64分,单是索内特四分.

blocks.en: Adding Opus’s own sentence to ACE’s candidate pool raises the reference-selected score (corpus BLEU over the per-item best pick) to 83.07. The pooled judge (using Sonnet for fluency) reaches 78.36 on these items and 76.95 on the full split, essentially tied with the gold+silver system ( Hajdik et al., 2019 ) . The judge (Sonnet) picks Opus’s sentence on 66.9% of items and an ACE candidate on the remaining 33.1%, close to the 65.2% of the reference selector, so the judge is not simply preferring model text.
blocks.zh: 将奥普斯自己的句子加进ACE候选人池,将参考选择的分数(公司BLEU比每个项目的最佳选择)提高到83.07. 集合法官(使用Sonnet进行流利)在这些项目上达到78.36人,在完全分割上达到76.95人,基本上与金+银系统挂钩(Hajdik等人,2019年). 法官(Sonnet)在66.9%的物品上选择Opus的句子,在剩余的33.1%的物品上选择ACE候选人,接近65.2%的参考选择者,因此法官并不单纯倾向于示范文本.

blocks.en: It does not by itself explain the realization results. A verbatim-continuation probe shows that Sonnet has seen some of the public text: it recalls 33% of one essay’s sentences and 0% on three control profiles, but recall is unrelated to realization quality. A second control swaps one content noun for another in both the MRS and the reference (140 pairs). BLEU is 3.17 points higher on the original pairs than on the substituted ones, the direction memorization would predict, the LLMs are still on par with the trained systems.
blocks.zh: 它本身并不能解释实现结果。 一个逐字记录式的连续探测显示,索内特看到了一些公开的文本:它回顾了33%的一篇散文的句子和0 %的三种控制剖面,但回忆与实现质量无关. 第二种控制在MRS和参考文献(140对)中将一个内容名词换成另一个内容名词. BLEU在原配对上比替代配对高3.17分,记忆的方向会预测,LLMS仍然与训练有素的系统相当.

blocks.en: 4 Parsing
blocks.zh: 4 分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Parsing the same 998 sentences (text → \rightarrow SimpleMRS; LLMs three-shot, ACE top-1 parse). Outputs decode as SimpleMRS for 97.1% (ACE, parse within resource limits), 96.3% (Opus) and 99.4% (Sonnet) of sentences; failures score 0. Whole graph : EDM F 1 with spans off (sf) and span-anchored (sa); exact graph match ignoring spans; Smatch F 1 over all triples. Relation F 1 : Smatch on edges only, with role labels (lab.) or ignoring them (unlab., attachment only). Recall : share of gold predicates named exactly (names), and share of gold edges recovered between correctly named nodes (edges). Calibration inputs are scored against gold: gold itself, gold with every predicate name replaced by a nonsense string, and one fixed MRS for every sentence.
blocks.zh: 表3: 解析相同的998句子(文本 ~\右旋简单MRS; LLMs 三拍, ACE 顶部-1 剖析). 产出解码为SimpleMRS(97.1%)(ACE,在资源限度内分析)、96.3%(Opus)和99.4%(Sonnet)的句子;失败分数 零点 整体图 : EDM F 1, 横跨( sf) 和 横跨( sa) ; 精确的图匹配忽略跨度 ; Smatch F 1 在所有三进制中. 关系F 1 :只在边缘上进行匹配,有角色标签(lab.)或忽略它们(unlab.,仅附件). 回顾 : 准确命名的黄金上游部分(名称),和正确命名的节点(对角)之间回收的黄金边缘部分. 校准输入以金为比分:黄金本身,黄金每个上游名称被胡言乱语的字符串取代,每个句子有一个固定的MRS.

blocks.en: Both models write MRS that decodes, but rarely the gold MRS (Table 3 ). ACE’s top parse matches gold exactly on 50.5% of sentences, but Opus does so on only 1.4% and Sonnet on 0.6%. On spans-off EDM the models trail ACE by 26 (Opus) and 34 (Sonnet) points.
blocks.zh: 两个型号都写有解码的MRS,但很少使用金色的MRS(表3 ). ACE的顶级解析与50.5%的句子完全吻合,但Opus只吻合1.4%,Sonnet则吻合0.6%. 在跨度EDM时,模型会以26(Opus)和34(Sonnet)的点数跟踪ACE.

blocks.en: The calibration rows show how to read these scores. Gold scores 100 on every metric. Gold with every predicate name junked (dummy word replacement) still scores 79.2 Smatch, level with Opus and above Sonnet, because Smatch rewards graph structure even when every name is wrong; a constant MRS still earns 33.1. Spans-off EDM and exact match fall to zero on both.
blocks.zh: 校准行显示如何读取这些分数. 黄金每分100分 黄金与每个上游名称 废(哑字替换) 仍然得79.2分。 Smatch,与Opus及以上Sonnet的级别,因为Smatch即使每个名字都是错误的,也会奖励图表结构;一个恒定的MRS仍然能赚到33.1. Spans -off EDM和精确的匹配 都降为0。

blocks.en: The failure is neither format, since 96–99% of outputs decode, nor total since, counting only which predicate lemmas appear ( _find_v_1 and _find_v_mental both count as find ; F 1 over the multiset, ignoring edges), the models score 78 (Sonnet) and 84 (Opus). It lies in the grammar’s conventions, at two levels. First, names: the models name only 65.48% (Sonnet) and 74% (Opus) of gold predicates exactly, against 93% for ACE, and the misses are plausible but incorrect ( _find_v_1 for _find_v_mental , compound omitted). Second, attachment: between correctly named nodes they recover 74% and 84% of gold edges, against 95% for ACE. These are wrong attachments, not wrong role labels. Ignoring labels raises relation F 1 only from 66.5 to 69.7 (Sonnet) and from 73.6 to 76.1 (Opus), far below ACE’s 91.1.
blocks.zh: 失败既非格式,因为96–99%的产出解码,也非总数据,因为只计算哪个上游lemma出现(_find_v_1和_find_v_mental都算为查找;F 1在多集之上,忽略边缘),模型得分78(Sonnet)和84(Opus). 它存在于语法的两层公约中。 首先,名称:模型仅准确命名65.48%(Sonnet)和74%(Opus)的黄金上游,而ACE为93%,误差合理但不正确(_find_v_1 for_find_v_mental,复合省略). 第二,附件:在正确命名的节点之间,它们回收了74%和84%的金边,而ACE则回收95%。 这些都是错误的附件,而不是错误的角色标签. 忽略标签只将关系F 1从66.5提高到69.7(Sonnet)和73.6提高到76.1(Opus),远低于ACE的91.1.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We ran Hajdik et al. ’s benchmark in both directions on the same sentences: from meaning representation to text, and from text back to meaning representation. The two directions give very different answers.
blocks.zh: 我们查过Hajdik等人 在同一句子上双向的基准:从表示到文字,从文字回向表示. 两个方向给出了非常不同的答案.

blocks.en: Going from MRS to text, prompted LLMs are strong. With three examples in the prompt, Sonnet matches the system trained on 72k gold pairs, and Opus beats it by about ten BLEU points and is level with the system that also used silver data. The sentences they write mostly keep the meaning of their input. Letting the models choose among the grammar’s own candidate sentences helps Sonnet by four points and Opus slightly.
blocks.zh: 从MRS到文本,激发的LLMs很强. Sonnet在提示中以三个例子与72k金配对的系统相匹配,Opus将其比分约10个BLEU点,并与同样使用银色数据的系统处于平面. 他们所写的句子大多保留了输入的意义. 让模型在文法中选择自己的候选句子有帮助 索内以四分和奥普斯略.

blocks.en: Going from text to MRS, the same models fail. They almost never produce the exact gold MRS. They mostly choose the right words but not the grammar’s exact predicate names or the way it attaches arguments.
blocks.zh: 从文本到MRS,相同的模型失败. 他们几乎从来没有生产 准确的黄金MRS。 他们大多选择正确的词,但不选择语法的准确的上游名称或附加论据的方式。

blocks.en: So a model can turn an MRS into a good sentence without being able to write that MRS itself. A high generation score should not be read as evidence that the model knows the representation.
blocks.zh: 所以一个模型可以把一个MRS变成一个好的句子,而不能够写出那个MRS本身. 高代分数不应被解读为模型知道代表值的证据.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate two Anthropic models under one prompting setup with three examples. Stronger setups, such as retrieval or constrained decoding, might narrow the parsing gap. Adding examples and enabling extended thinking did not close it. Our aim is to measure what prompted models can do on their own and combining them with constrained decoding is future work.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个Anthropic模型 在一个提示设置下 有三个例子 较强的设置,如检索或受限制的解码,可能会缩小解析差距. 添加实例和允许扩展思维并没有结束。 我们的目标是衡量促使模型独自做些什么,并将其与受限制的解码相结合,这是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix A Appendix
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Hajdik et al. (2019) ’s linearizer fails on 266 of the 10,201 test items (blank lines in their released source file). We score the remaining 9,935 minus the three held-out exemplars, 9,932 items. ACE generates for 7,865 of these.
blocks.zh: Hajdik et al. (2019) 的线性化器在10,201个测试项目中的266个(在其释放源文件中的宽线)上失效. 剩下的9 935分减去三个被搁置的例子,9 932分。 ACE为其中的7,865个生成.

blocks.en: Sonnet and the judge use temperature 0 and a 3,000-token limit. Opus 5 does not accept a temperature and runs at its default thinking.
blocks.zh: 索内特和法官使用温度0和3000托肯的限制. Opus 5不接受温度,并按默认思维运行.

blocks.en: ACE parses each system’s sentence (top-1), and we score the parse against the input MRS with spans-off EDM. Sentences ACE cannot parse score zero. As a reference, the same procedure applied to the gold sentence gives 91.0 on the 1000 items.
blocks.zh: ACE解析每个系统的句子(Top-1),我们用跨度的EDM对输入的MRS进行分数。 ACE 无法解析分数 0 。 作为参考,对1 000件物品适用同样的黄金判决程序为91.0件。

blocks.en: The verbatim probe gives Sonnet the opening of a sentence from the test documents and checks whether it continues it word for word. The substitution control replaces one content noun with a different noun of the same length in both the MRS and the reference and compares BLEU on original and substituted pairs.
blocks.zh: 逐字记录显示 Sonnet从测试文件中打开一个句子,并检查它是否逐字延续. 替代控制在MRS和参考文献中用一个长度相同的不同名词取代一个内容名词,并在原配对和替代配对上比较BLEU.

blocks.en: We read gold and predicted SimpleMRS with PyDelphin 1.11 and convert both to EDS graphs. An output that cannot be read scores zero on every metric.
blocks.zh: 我们用PyDelphin 1.11读出金文和预测的SimleMRS,并转换成EDS图. 无法在每个度量上读取的输出为零 。

blocks.en: EDM splits a graph into small facts: which predicates it contains, which arguments link them, and which features (tense, number, and so on) they carry. It then counts how many of the gold facts the prediction also contains, reporting precision, recall and F 1 . In the span-anchored version, a predicted node matches a gold node only if both cover the same stretch of the sentence. In the spans-off version, nodes match by predicate name alone.
blocks.zh: EDM将一个图表分成小事实:它包含哪些上游,哪些论据将它们联系起来,以及它们携带的哪些特征(强度,数量等). 然后,它计算出预测中包含、报告准确性、召回和F 1的黄金事实。 在横断断续续的版本中,一个预言的节点只匹配一个黄金节点,只要两者覆盖句子的相同长度. 在跨度关闭版本中,节点仅通过上游名称匹配.

blocks.en: Exact match asks whether the predicted graph is the gold graph with only the variable labels changed, ignoring spans. We check this with a standard graph-matching search, which finished on every item.
blocks.zh: 精确匹配询问预测的图表是否是只有可变标签更改的金色图表,忽略了跨度. 我们用一个标准的图比搜索来检查它,它在每个项目上都完成了.

blocks.en: Smatch is the usual AMR metric, applied to the EDS graphs. It finds the pairing of predicted and gold nodes that makes the most facts agree, then scores those facts. It searches for this pairing at random, so repeated runs can differ by about 0.3.
blocks.zh: Smatch是常用的AMR度量衡,应用于EDS图中. 它发现了预言和黄金节点的配对,使得大多数事实都同意,然后对这些事实进行评分. 它随机搜索这种配对,所以重复运行可能相差约0.3.

blocks.en: Predicate-lemma overlap ignores edges and sense labels. _find_v_1 and _find_v_mental both count as find , and we compute F 1 between the two lists of lemmas. Edge recall pairs each gold node with a predicted node that has exactly the same predicate name. It then asks what share of the gold edges between paired nodes also appear, with the same label, in the prediction.
blocks.zh: Predicate-lemma重叠忽略边缘和感官标签. _find_v_1和_find_v_mental都算作找到,我们在两个lemma列表中计算F 1. Edge召回每个黄金节点的对子,有一个具有完全相同上游名称的预测节点. 然后它又问,在预测中,成对的节点之间的黄金边缘也会出现什么份额,有相同的标签.

blocks.en: We use SacreBLEU 2.6 with its default settings (13a tokenization, exponential smoothing, one reference).
blocks.zh: 我们使用 SacreBleU 2.6 及其默认设置( 13a a sorderization, 指数平滑, 一个参考) 。

blocks.en: The reference selector picks, for each item, the candidate closest to the reference sentence by BLEU. It looks at the answer, so it only shows how good the candidate list could be; no real system can use it. Picking the best sentence one at a time does not quite maximize corpus BLEU, so we also report a corpus-BLEU selector . It starts from the same picks and keeps swapping candidates as long as corpus BLEU goes up.
blocks.zh: 参考选择器为每个项目选择最接近BLEU参考句的候选人. 它审视了答案,因此只能显示候选名单能有多好;没有真正的系统可以使用. 一次挑一个最好的句子 并不会使BLEU最大化 所以我们也报告一个BLEU选手 只要BLEU的血清上升,它就从同样的抽取开始,不断交换候选人。

blocks.en: Each prompt has a system message, then three worked examples, then the test item. • Realization. “You are an expert in the English Resource Grammar (ERG) and Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS). You are given a linearized Dependency MRS graph. Write the English sentence it represents. Tokens like named0, named1, month0 are placeholders for named entities: copy them through verbatim in your output. Output only the sentence, with no explanation, no quotes and no markup.” Examples are Graph: / Sentence: pairs. • Parsing. “You are an expert linguistic annotator producing Minimal Recursion Semantics in the DELPH-IN SimpleMRS format used by the English Resource Grammar. Output ONLY the MRS.” Examples are Sentence: / MRS: pairs. • Judge. “You are a careful editor of written English. You will be shown numbered candidate sentences that are all intended to express the same meaning. Choose the single most fluent, natural and well-formed English sentence. Output only its number.” The user message lists the candidates and ends with “Answer with the number only.”
blocks.zh: 每个提示有一个系统消息,然后三个工作的例子,然后是测试项目. • 实现。 “你是英语资源语法(ERG)和最小溯源语义学(MRS)的专家。 您将获得线性依赖性 MRS 图表 。 写它所代表的英文句子. 命名为0, 命名为1, 月份为指定实体的占位符 : 在输出中逐字复制 。 只输出句子,没有解释,没有引用,也没有加分。” 例如图:/句子:对。 解析。 “你是一个语言学专家,用英语资源语法所使用的DELPH-IN SimpleMRS格式,制作最小检索语义。 仅输出MRS。” 例如判决:/MRS:对。 “你认真编辑书面英语。 将显示所有旨在表达相同含义的备选句子。 选择最流利,自然和造型良好的英语单句. 只输出其编号。” 用户信息列出候选人,最后以“仅回答数字。 “
